_comment: Fictional persona for SOH-221 stress data. No real people.
name: Rachel Adler
about_me: I'm Rachel, an associate at Northwind Climate Fund in Detroit, working for Priya Rao. I source seed-stage climate hardware: batteries, grid, ag sensing. I'm looking for student founders at Michigan building real hardware.
goals: Source five climate-hardware founders from Michigan this semester

debriefs.text: Priya Rao, my partner, wants more student deal flow and said she'll take a meeting with any founder a known operator vouches for. She's especially interested in grid storage.
Met Diego Ramirez at Detroit Hardware Night. He's the founder of SoilSense, soil-moisture sensors for urban farms, with 40 units in Detroit gardens. He's raising $600k pre-seed.
Coffee with Keisha Morrow, who runs Maize Launch, the campus accelerator. Applications close November 15 and she wants more hardware teams. She offered to share the hardware applicants with us.

Talked to Prof. Helena Brandt, mechanical engineering, who runs a battery research lab. She has two students thinking of spinning out a thermal-management startup. I promised to send her our founder FAQ.
Met Grace Adeyemi, president of Michigan Venture Club. She's looking for funds to host on the Chicago VC trek. Said Northwind would be a great stop.
Omar Haddad from GridLeaf sent his updated deck. He's hiring a power electronics lead and Priya is still considering the round.
